brief:
Jewish organizations worldwide have issued an open letter urging their peers to publicly endorse the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement, according to Mondoweiss. The signatories frame BDS as a coordinated nonviolent pressure campaign designed to end what they characterize as Israeli impunity for actions in the occupied territories.

The letter represents a push to build institutional support for the Palestinian-led movement within the Jewish community. BDS targets Israel through economic and political means, calling for boycotts of Israeli goods and services, divestment from Israeli companies and institutions, and sanctions against the Israeli government. The initiative seeks to leverage Jewish organizational influence to advance the campaign's stated goals regarding Palestinian rights and Israeli accountability.
dek: A call for Jewish organizations around the world to publicly endorse the BDS movement and support coordinated nonviolent pressure to end Israeli impunity.
title: Global Jewish organizations call for BDS endorsement in open letter
